title: Installation Jobs: Sill Adder for Rotted Sills Under Lead-Safe Work
content:
**Rotted sills and lead-safe work — Installation Jobs**

Rotted sills cut out on an **Installation Jobs** record disturb painted framing. When the lead-safe fee of the job is priced, a sill adder follows the linear feet covered by the rot repair charged on the job — the total linear feet on the job's rot repair charges:

| Linear feet covered by rot repair charged on the job | Sill adder |
|---|---|
| more than 10 | $60.00 |
| 10 or less (any rot repair up to 10 linear feet) | $30.00 |
| no rot repair | none |

The adder is a single amount for the job, added to the fee.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical rot repair charges)

| Rot repair charges on the job | Linear feet covered | Sill adder |
|---|---|---|
| one charge for 11 feet | 11 | $60.00 |
| one charge for 6 feet and one for 4 feet | 10 | $30.00 |
| one charge for 1 foot | 1 | $30.00 |
| one charge for half a foot | 0.5 | $30.00 |
| none | 0 | none |
